begin
 nullchk ;
 check_package_failure ;
--
 begin
 select distinct batch_id
 into :ctrl_blk_1.pt_batch_id
 from pt_batch_hdr
 where batch_id = :ctrl_blk_1.pt_batch_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and reviewed_flag = 'N' ;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 show_error('1130') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
end;

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 lnCount number;
begin
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;

 /* Following added by HCL-C to check when no records are retrieved */
 BEGIN
 SELECT count(*) INTO lnCount
 FROM PT_BATCH_DET
 WHERE batch_id = :ctrl_blk_1.pt_batch_id 
 AND test_id = :ctrl_blk_1.test_id 
 AND exp_result is null
 AND exp_absorbance is null ;
 IF lnCount > 0 THEN
 go_block('pt_batch_det');
 execute_query;
 ELSE
 show_error('2331');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 END ;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 if :exp_result is null then
 return ;
 end if ;
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 begin
 select result_status, substr(code_desc,1,30)
 into :exp_result, :s_result_desc
 from valid_test_results v, master_codes m
 where result_status = :exp_result
 and test_id = :ctrl_blk_1.test_id
 and result_status = code
 and code_type = 'RESUL'
 and sysdate between v.eff_date
 and nvl(v.term_date,sysdate+365)
 and sysdate between m.eff_date
 and nvl(m.term_date,sysdate+365)
 and rownum < 2;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 show_error('1201') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
end;

end if;
